query: db.trials.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "start_year": 1 }, output: { moving_avg: { $avg: "$enrollment_count", window: { documents: [-2, 0] } } } } }, { $facet: { ranked: [{ $sort: { moving_avg: -1 } }, { $project: { _id: 0, trial_id: 1, moving_avg: 1, category: "$trial_phase" } }], baseline: [{ $group: { _id: null, global_avg: { $avg: "$moving_avg" } } }] } }, { $project: { kept: { $filter: { input: "$ranked", as: "row", cond: { $gt: ["$$row.moving_avg", { $arrayElemAt: ["$baseline.global_avg", 0] }] } } } } }, { $unwind: "$kept" }, { $project: { _id: 0, trial_id: "$kept.trial_id", moving_avg: "$kept.moving_avg", category: "$kept.category" } }])
